## What is the current behavior?
<!-- Please describe the current behavior that you are modifying, or link to a relevant issue. -->
The current description of the [ContentChildren](https://angular.io/api/core/ContentChildren) metadata properties gives the following description for the `descendants` property:

> descendants - include only direct children or all descendants.

While this describes what it does, it is unclear which strategy is used on `descendents: true`

Issue Number: #20074

## What is the new behavior?
The documentation will indicate that the boolean refers to whether to include all descendants and defaults to only direct children.

```
[ ] Yes

```

body:
For anyone looking at this issue / working on a doc - the actual behaviour / governing rules are quite subtle, please see https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/14769#issuecomment-356609267

Also, any documentation update should contain mention from https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/13002#issuecomment-263981202

@kapunahelewong actually, after discussing this some more with @mhevery we want to change the current behaviour, as it is just too confusing. A new proposal is here: https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/14769#issuecomment-356901874

Given the above we should hold off any work on documentation till #14769 is resolved - otherwise we would be documenting a "moving target"
